purpose: Customer-safe action registry for Segmently launch DO mode. It lets an installed Claude/Codex skill resolve a customer request to a CLI delegation, browser runner action, handoff, or explicit unsupported reason without reading project source.
usage: Resolve the customer request to one action id before doing anything.
For mode=cli, delegate execution to owningSkill; do not reimplement command syntax in the launch guide.
For mode=e2e and status=supported, call runtime/editor-do-runner.mjs with the action id and required inputs, then run the verify read.
For status=unsupported or handoff, explain the reason and use the teachFallback article/reference when available.

runnerContract.executeCli: CLI actions return an execution object with owningSkill, commandFamily, argv/materialize hints, and a verification object. Route execution to owningSkill; do not freehand command syntax.
runnerContract.executeE2e: E2E actions return a playwright-bowser execution object with open/run-code/close commands, driverScript, browserPlan, segmently-test-kit companion dependency, and a verification object for the active Codex environment.
runnerContract.unsupported: Unsupported actions must return unsupportedReason plus teachFallback. Do not silently degrade to a fake success.
